[Skip to main content](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/introduction#__docusaurus_skipToContent_fallback)

🚀 [DeepAgent is now Abacus AI Agent](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/introduction)

On this page

Abacus.AI **Super Assistant**, also known as **ChatLLM Teams**, is an all-in-one AI platform for professionals, students, and teams. One subscription gives you every top Large Language Model, a powerful AI agent that can build and act on your behalf, an always-on cloud computer, and a full creative studio — all in a single interface.

![Super Assistant Main Page](https://abacus.ai/help/assets/images/super_assistant_main_page-9a01301ab7b38f4b2ac9c430c9890dd9.webp)

## Access All the Top LLMs [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/introduction\#access-all-the-top-llms "Direct link to Access All the Top LLMs")

Instead of juggling multiple AI subscriptions, ChatLLM gives you every state-of-the-art model in one place — GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5, Claude Fable 5.1, Grok 4.6, and many more. Pick a model from the selector, or leave it on **RouteLLM**, which automatically routes each prompt to the best model for the job. You can even create your own custom router.

![LLM Selector with all top models](https://abacus.ai/help/assets/images/chatllm_llm_selector-b2aac190eb42c6b34dd4e0af291bd227.webp)

New models are added within days of release, and generous usage limits let you send thousands of messages per month on top-tier models without hitting quotas.

## The Abacus AI Agent — Your AI That Acts [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/introduction\#the-abacus-ai-agent--your-ai-that-acts "Direct link to The Abacus AI Agent — Your AI That Acts")

The **Abacus AI Agent** doesn't just answer questions — it gets work done end-to-end. Switch to **Agent** mode (or let **Auto** decide) and it can:

- **Build apps and websites** — describe what you want and the Agent builds, tests, and deploys full-stack apps with hosting, databases, and custom domains. See the [Agent Apps How-To](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/deepagent-apps).
- **Run automated and self-improving workflows** — schedule recurring tasks that run hands-off and get measurably better over time. See [Agent Tasks](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/deepagent-tasks) and [Self-Improving Tasks and Agents](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/self-improving-tasks-and-agents).
- **Do your office work** — create presentations, documents, and spreadsheets, perform deep research with live web browsing, analyze data, and generate reports.

![Assistant modes: Auto, Chat, Agent, and Custom Bots](https://abacus.ai/help/assets/images/chatllm_assistant_modes-26eb1bf9cd735c639a2206f459ec1c76.webp)

Read the full [Abacus AI Agent How-To](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/deepagent) to unlock everything it can do.

## SuperComputer — Your Always-On Cloud Computer [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/introduction\#supercomputer--your-always-on-cloud-computer "Direct link to SuperComputer — Your Always-On Cloud Computer")

**SuperComputer** is your personal, always-on (24/7) cloud computer for more powerful technical work: a full Ubuntu VM with root access, SSH, databases, storage, and public URLs. Use it to host services, run heavy compute, keep AI agents running around the clock, and deploy anything — from 3D game servers to trading bots — with simple prompts or directly from the terminal.

![SuperComputer page with terminal](https://abacus.ai/help/assets/images/supercomputer_page-70eda0c0e3f3c1bc8cfd319348872c3b.webp)

**How is it different from the Agent?** The Agent is the brain; SuperComputer is the infra:

- The **Agent** runs tasks end-to-end in a managed environment — ideal for building apps, research, documents, and workflows that finish and deliver a result.
- **SuperComputer** is a persistent machine that stays on — ideal for hosting services continuously, installing any software, and workloads that need root access, full networking, or long-running compute.

They work best together: the Agent can build on your SuperComputer, and SuperComputer keeps what you build running. See the [Abacus AI SuperComputer guide](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/supercomputer) for a detailed comparison.

## Abacus AI Studio — Create Anything, Instantly [​](https://abacus.ai/help/chatllm-ai-super-assistant/introduction\#abacus-ai-studio--create-anything-instantly "Direct link to Abacus AI Studio — Create Anything, Instantly")

**Abacus AI Studio** is the creative suite built into your assistant. Generate images, videos, music, and voiceovers with the latest generative models — plus purpose-built tools for explainers, ads, and avatars, a video editor, and voice agents. Everything you create lands in one place, ready to refine or reuse.

![Abacus AI Studio](https://abacus.ai/help/assets/images/abacus_ai_studio-6e2436c4ffaf5996568583ef2cc6b57e.webp)

Learn more in the [Abacus AI Studio help](https://studio.abacus.ai/help).
